# Stock Portfolio Pro - full LLM context

This document is a long-form description of Stock Portfolio Pro, designed to be
loaded as full context for an LLM answering user questions about the product.

## One-line summary

Stock Portfolio Pro is a web-based portfolio tracker and fundamentals dashboard
for long-term retail investors. Free no-signup demo, then GBP 7/month with a
7-day free trial.

## Canonical URLs

- Landing page: https://stockportfolio.pro/
- Free demo (no signup): https://stockportfolio.pro/demo
- Demo fundamentals view: https://stockportfolio.pro/demo/fundamentals
- Pricing / signup: https://stockportfolio.pro/register
- Privacy: https://stockportfolio.pro/privacy
- Terms: https://stockportfolio.pro/terms
- Support: https://stockportfolio.pro/support

## What it does

Stock Portfolio Pro lets a user track a stock portfolio without connecting any
brokerage account. Positions are entered manually (symbol, shares, buy price).
The app then:

1. Fetches real-time and historical prices via Yahoo Finance.
2. Computes total value, day change, total gain/loss, and per-holding P/L.
3. Renders an allocation donut chart and a performance time-series chart
   (5D / 1M / 6M / 1Y / ALL ranges) using hand-rolled D3.js v7 visuals.
4. Provides a separate "Fundamentals" workspace that shows company financial
   statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow) and key ratios for
   any tickered company.

## Who it is for

- Long-term retail investors who add positions periodically and want a calm,
  ad-free view of their portfolio.
- Investors who do not want to connect broker credentials to a third-party app.
- Users who want a fundamentals research view without paying for Bloomberg /
  Koyfin.

## Who it is not for

- High-frequency traders (no order routing, no streaming tick data).
- Options / derivatives traders (equities only).
- Users who want auto-sync from broker accounts.

## Pricing

- Free demo: https://stockportfolio.pro/demo - read-only, no signup, sample
  5-stock portfolio with live prices.
- Monthly plan: GBP 7 / month after a 7-day free trial.
- Annual plan: GBP 70 / year (saves GBP 14 vs monthly billing).
- Cancel anytime from account settings.

## Demo walkthrough script

1. Open https://stockportfolio.pro/demo - no login required.
2. The yellow banner at the top confirms read-only DEMO MODE.
3. The KPI tiles show Total Value, Day Change, Total Gain/Loss, and number of
   Holdings for a sample 5-stock portfolio.
4. The Portfolio Value chart shows time-series performance; toggle 5D / 1M /
   6M / 1Y / ALL ranges.
5. The Allocation donut shows the percentage weight of each holding.
6. The Holdings table lists each position with shares, buy price, current
   price, total cost, market value, and P/L.
7. To see the fundamentals view, click Fundamentals or go directly to
   https://stockportfolio.pro/demo/fundamentals.
8. To create a real portfolio, click "Start free trial" - this starts the 7-day
   free trial via Stripe.

## Tech stack

- Frontend: vanilla JavaScript, HTML, CSS (no framework), D3.js v7 for charts.
- Backend: Node.js + Express on Render.
- Database: MongoDB Atlas.
- Auth: JWT with Google and Facebook OAuth providers.
- Market data: yahoo-finance2 npm package.
- Payments: Stripe (subscription billing, 7-day free trial).
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4 (consent-gated, ad/analytics storage denied by
  default).
- Security: helmet middleware, rate limiting on /api routes.

## Privacy posture

- Account and portfolio data are used only to provide the service.
- Analytics storage is denied by default; users opt in.
- Broker credentials are never collected.
- See https://stockportfolio.pro/privacy for the full policy.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is Stock Portfolio Pro financial advice?
A: No. It is an analysis and visualization tool only.

Q: Do I need to connect a broker account?
A: No. Positions are added manually.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: Yes, from account settings. The subscription will not renew.

Q: What happens after the 7-day trial?
A: The monthly plan continues at GBP 7 / month unless cancelled before the
trial ends.

Q: Is there an annual plan?
A: Yes - GBP 70 / year, saving GBP 14 vs monthly.

Q: How is my data handled?
A: Account and portfolio data are used to provide the service. Analytics are
optional and only enabled with consent.
